description: Log in to TronSave for the rest of this MCP connection. Provide EXACTLY ONE of: `signature` = `<signature>_<timestamp>` produced by the user's wallet over the `message` from `tronsave_get_sign_message` (unlocks wallet tools; also loads the wallet's internal API key if it has one), or `apiKey` = raw TronSave internal API key (unlocks internal-account tools and `paymentMethod=internal`). The login is bound to the current `mcp-session-id` automatically — do not pass session ids in later tool arguments. Returns `{ sessionId, authMode, walletAddress?, hasInternalApiKey, expiresAt, unlocked }`. Signed timestamps older than the server limit (default 24h) are rejected with `SIGNATURE_EXPIRED`. Never ask the user for private keys or seed phrases.

apiKey.description: Raw API key for internal-tools login. Provide EXACTLY ONE of `apiKey` or `signature`.

signature.description: Signature token in `signature_timestamp` format (timestamp is the signed message). Provide EXACTLY ONE of `apiKey` or `signature`.

name: tronsave_login
